name: Live TV (M3U)
description: Your own IPTV channels from an M3U playlist, with their programme guide from XMLTV.

listing.summary: Watch the channels of an M3U playlist (your IPTV subscription, or a public list) with a programme guide.
listing.description: Paste the address of an M3U playlist in its settings, and optionally of an XMLTV guide (else the one the playlist names). The channels show in a Live TV section with their programmes; the server plays HLS and MPEG-TS streams. The plugin carries no list of its own.
listing.disclaimer: Only add playlists you are allowed to watch. Playpex is an educational project.

settings.label: Playlist (M3U)
settings.description: The address of your M3U playlist: http or https, as your provider gives it.

settings.label: Programme guide (XMLTV)
settings.description: Optional: an XMLTV file (.xml or .xml.gz). Empty: the guide the playlist names, if any.

settings.label: Use the guide the playlist names
settings.description: When no guide address is given above.

settings.label: Only these groups
settings.description: Group names, separated by commas. Empty: every channel.
